THE PROBLEM

Why it matters

Students lose track of deadlines across subjects, and LMS interfaces feel like admin software.

DESIGN APPROACH

Approach

A "today" view with what is due, course cards with visible progress, and friendly empty states.

Key features

  • 01Course cards with progress
  • 02Deadline timeline
  • 03Lesson player
  • 04Teacher grading view
